name: Druid
summary: A full prepared caster off Wisdom whose list is the wild, with a companion and, from 4th, another shape.

pools._note: Uses per day, Core p.51: 1 at 4th, +1 every two levels after.

_note_wild_shape: Forms and uses per day, Core Rulebook p.51 and the class table (d20pfsrd, checked 2026-10-04): elementals from 6th (Small), plants from 8th (Small or Medium). This table said elemental at 8th and plant at 10th, and named no uses per day after 4th.

choices.name: Nature's Bond
choices.text: At 1st level a druid forms a bond with nature: either one cleric domain, with its spells and powers at her druid level, or an animal companion that advances as she does (Core Rulebook, Druid).

options.name: A cleric domain
options.text: Its granted powers at your druid level, and one extra domain spell slot at every spell level you can cast, which must hold that domain's spell.

options.name: An animal companion
options.text: A loyal animal that travels with you and grows with your druid level. It hears what you say as an animal does: the tricks it knows, and your tone.

grants: wild shape (Large or Tiny animal, Small elemental)
wild shape (Huge or Diminutive animal, Medium elemental, Small or Medium plant)
